description: The filings also show Smith is the only candidate among the race's top fundraisers who has not received large amounts of support from out-of-state donors and PAC money. Smith's campaign continues to be powered overwhelmingly by individual donors from within Wisconsin.

title: Brad Smith Leads All Challengers to Incumbent Glenn Grothman in Fundraising, FEC Filings Show — Brad Smith for Wisconsin
